objective: Correct A48 from a face-level F26/SG branch shorthand to the exact existential low-slack witness relation of C48, preserve per-witness and per-selected-gap provenance, and integrate the newly completed S09 exact C37 source-registry/lineage bridges.

atomic_claims.text: C48 proves that every unpaid negative face has at least one low-slack witness corner p and that F versus SG is exclusive for each fixed witness p; it does not prove face-level exclusivity between existence of F witnesses and existence of SG witnesses.

For an SG witness the singleton gap is existential and may be nonunique; C48's 192 normalized directions are the atlas for one selected singleton gap, not a complete census of all SG states for the corner or face.

Merged S09 supplies a repository-bound exact 160-parent C37 d(7)=6 source registry partitioned 96 direct-fan, 60 other merged-catalogue, and 4 bare-delete rows, repairing the prior missing-source blocker at candidate level.

S09 supplies candidate REG37, LINEAGE37 and exact D/19 identity bridges; combined with S06/S10 these conditionally eliminate the exact C37 d(7)=6 leaf once GSRC/JMAP identifies that exact source, but they do not prove A48-to-C37 generation or global L_join.

assumptions: C48 theorem text is interpreted with its explicit choose-a-corner quantifier and no face-level selector is inferred.
Arithmetic countermodels are used only to refute an arithmetic implication and are not asserted geometrically realizable.
S09 exact-parent inheritance is used only under its five source-lineage preservation conditions.
S10 clean-room corroboration remains candidate-level, not a registered trusted verifier.
Ordinary and anchored lanes remain disjoint.
risks: LSRC/GSRC must carry witness and selected-gap provenance or prove a sound selector; no such completed bridge is imported.
Multiple witness/gap descriptions may alias the same global source and must be resolved by JMAP rather than assumed unique.
S09 covers exact C37 d(7)=6 only and cannot be extrapolated to S02-B d(7)>=7 states.
General arbitrary-exterior lifting remains unverified at trusted theorem level despite S09's specialized path-composition bridge.
B-criticality, S04, S14 and unique L_join remain open.
